name: Profiling Elon Musk's Twitter/X evolution (Zenodo, CC-BY-4.0)
what: Research record with two CSVs of Musk tweets: Dataset 1 (complete tweets, emotion annotation) and Dataset 2 (political annotation). Columns include text, created_at, tweet_id, favorite/retweet/reply/view counts.
why_it_matters: Joinable to our 92,380-post Zenodo corpus on tweet_id for the overlapping 2010-2025 window; gives licence-clean (CC-BY) copy of part of the corpus with annotations.
numbers: Dataset 1: 60,567 tweets; Dataset 2: 18,262 tweets; range 2010-06-04 to 2025-01-24 (Zenodo record page, fetched 2026-10-14). Record published 2025-03-21, v2.
ui_notes: Raw CSV rows; no per-post UI. Fields: text, characters, target, type, favorite_count, retweet_count, reply_count, view_count, created_at, tweet_id, emotion (Dataset 1) or category_labelling (Dataset 2).
note: Licence CC-BY-4.0 stated on record. Tweet text redistribution still subject to X terms for the underlying content; attribute the record.

name: Elon Musk Tweets 2010 to 2025 (April) - Kaggle (dadalyndell)
what: Kaggle dataset of @elonmusk posts plus the original tweets he quote-posted; compiled for a 2025 investigation into Kremlin disinformation.
why_it_matters: Newest full-history-style Musk file found (through April 2025), so it extends our corpus by about 1 month past May-2025 only if it is not already in the Zenodo set; mainly useful as a cross-check.
numbers: Search snippet says posts run through 2025-04-13; row count not read (Kaggle page fetch returned only the title). Source: WebSearch result, 2026-10-14.
ui_notes: Kaggle table view (CSV preview). No per-post UI.
note: Licence NOT read (Kaggle page did not render it). Check the Kaggle licence field before any redistribution; X terms apply to content.

name: Elon Musk Tweets (Daily Updated) - Kaggle (aryansingh0909)
what: Kaggle dataset titled as daily-updated Musk tweets, collected with snscrape.
why_it_matters: Only candidate found that claims post-May-2025 freshness, but the method is one widely reported as broken for X, so 2026 coverage is doubtful.
numbers: No row count or last date verified. Source: WebSearch snippet, 2026-10-14.
ui_notes: Kaggle CSV preview only.
note: Licence not read. Verify the newest tweet date before counting it as newer than May 2025.

name: dawood/elon-tweets (Hugging Face)
what: Small CSV of Musk tweets on Hugging Face.
why_it_matters: Licence is clean and explicit, but it is small and old, so it adds little beyond our corpus.
numbers: Last upload shown as January 2023 (HF page snippet, 2026-10-14). Row count not verified.
ui_notes: HF dataset viewer table; no per-post UI.
note: Licence afl-3.0 (Academic Free License 3.0) per HF page snippet. Content is X posts; terms apply.

name: MasaFoundation/elonmusk_elon_tweets (Hugging Face)
what: Parquet dataset of Musk tweets on Hugging Face.
why_it_matters: Possible post-2024 coverage check; not confirmed.
numbers: Size band 1K-10K rows; last update August 2024 (HF snippet, 2026-10-14). No 2025-2026 coverage shown.
ui_notes: HF dataset viewer; parquet preview.
note: Licence not visible in snippet; open the HF card before use.

name: Lexicap (Karpathy) - Lex Fridman Whisper transcripts
what: Karpathy's project: Whisper (large, English) transcripts of Lex Fridman Podcast episodes, with a zip download of raw caption data.
why_it_matters: Only free, whole-episode, timestamped transcript set for Lex Fridman guests including Musk (episodes #1 onward); lets us pull Musk's spoken words from episodes with machine timestamps.
numbers: Episode count not confirmed. Fetch of karpathy.ai/lexicap returned the homepage, not the Lexicap page, so the URL is search-indexed only (WebSearch 2026-10-14). Musk episodes: #400 (2023-11-09) at minimum.
ui_notes: Per-episode caption files with timestamps (per search description); verify on the live page.
note: Licence not stated on the pages read. Lex Fridman content is his; treat as research use; check before redistribution. The URL returned the Karpathy homepage on fetch, so re-check it.

name: Lex Fridman #400 Elon Musk transcript (official site)
what: Lex Fridman's own human-generated transcript of episode #400 with Elon Musk, speaker-labelled, with clickable timestamps.
why_it_matters: Verbatim, dated, timestamped Musk speech with a stable URL per quote possible via timestamp anchor; the best template for a 'said' row.
numbers: Episode #400 published 2023-11-09 (YouTube description via WebSearch). Transcript page length about 148,800 characters (fetch, 2026-10-14). Only the first 100,000 characters were read.
ui_notes: Speaker labels ('Lex Fridman', 'Elon Musk'); each line starts with a clickable (00:00:00) timestamp linking to the video.
note: Page says transcript is human generated and may have errors. No licence text seen in the first 100k chars; treat as Lex Fridman copyright, quote with attribution.

name: Joe Rogan Experience #2223 Elon Musk full transcript (TurboScribe share)
what: Full machine transcript of JRE #2223 with Musk (Nov 2024) on a TurboScribe share page.
why_it_matters: Musk long-form interview transcript; shows the kind of third-party transcript source available for podcasts we do not index.
numbers: Episode date Nov 2024 (per URL title/search snippet, 2026-10-14). Word count not read.
ui_notes: Share page with transcript and export options.
note: Machine transcript, not checked for accuracy. Joe Rogan / Spotify content is copyrighted; use for research only, do not republish.

name: Factbase: Trump interview with Sean Hannity with Elon Musk (2025-02-18)
what: Roll Call Factbase transcript of a Fox News Hannity interview with Trump and Musk, aired 2025-02-18.
why_it_matters: Shows Factbase's per-event transcript page as a UI pattern for dated, speaker-attributed quotes with Musk in the room.
numbers: Aired 2025-02-18; full version released 2025-02-19 on Fox Nation (page text, 2026-10-14).
ui_notes: Factbase transcript page: dated header, speaker-labelled text, Trump-centric.
note: Transcript credited to Fox News; Factbase terms not read.

name: The Book of Elon (Eric Jorgenson)
what: Curated book of Musk's ideas from his own words (Twitter, podcasts, videos, essays), by Eric Jorgenson; later edition 'The Book of Elon: A Guide to Purpose and Success' listed March 2026.
why_it_matters: A curated quote book, not an archive: useful as a seed list of quotes to trace back to dated primary sources, not as a citable corpus.
numbers: Edition date March 2026 per one listing (WebSearch snippet, 2026-10-14). Sales figures unverified. No per-quote source list seen.
ui_notes: Print book; quotes unsourced in marketing copy.
note: Copyrighted book; quote short excerpts only with citation.

name: Graciousquotes - Elon Musk quotes with sources
what: Quote list that labels each quote as verified or plausible against an original source.
why_it_matters: Its verified/plausible labelling is a model for our per-quote verification field.
numbers: Search snippet: 7 Musk quotes checked, 3 verified to original source (WebSearch, 2026-10-14). Too small to use as a corpus.
ui_notes: Quote, then source label; verified vs plausible status shown per quote.
note: Small site; licence not read. Quotes themselves are not copyrighted, but cite the site only as a pointer.

name: Glasp - Elon Musk quotes page
what: Glasp author page listing quotes attributed to Musk, drawn from highlights of YouTube and web content.
why_it_matters: Shows the highlight-to-quote pipeline, where each quote points to a source video; useful as a pointer list.
numbers: About 156 quotes by author per search snippet (WebSearch, 2026-10-14). No dates per quote seen in snippet.
ui_notes: Quote list; source link behind each quote (not confirmed).
note: Quotes are user-highlighted, not verbatim-checked. Glasp terms not read.

name: Trump Twitter Archive (trumptwitterarchive.com)
what: Per-account search archive of @realDonaldTrump tweets (the reference per-person archive UI).
why_it_matters: The canonical per-person archive UI; could not be fetched today (DNS failure on www host, and fetch failure on bare host), so current status is BLOCKED, not confirmed.
numbers: Not verified. Earlier snippets not read.
ui_notes: Search box plus tweet list; device and deleted flags not confirmed by fetch.
note: Status BLOCKED (fetch failed 2026-10-14). Wayback fetch blocked in this environment.

name: bpb27/political_twitter_archive (GitHub)
what: Per-account folders of political-figure tweets, including realdonaldtrump, potus, vp, whitehouse; each folder has a CSV, user_ids.json, user_long.zip (full JSON with metadata) and user_short.zip.
why_it_matters: Best bulk-download pattern for a per-person archive; a per-person folder layout we can copy for Musk.
numbers: 14 commits (repo page, 2026-10-14). README says the separate Trump repo auto-updates hourly; last commit date and total tweet count not shown.
ui_notes: Folder per account; CSV for spreadsheets, JSON for full metadata.
note: Licence not stated; README says 'Feel free to use the data.' Treat as permissive but confirm with the author before redistribution. Tweets remain X content.

name: Politwoops (ProPublica) - archive of deleted politician posts
what: Archive of deleted tweets by politicians and officials; each deleted tweet has its own page.
why_it_matters: The only public deleted-post archive for officials; no current Musk coverage, and it stopped tracking deletions in early 2023. Shows how a deleted post is labelled.
numbers: Site notice: archive 'no longer maintained', partial snapshot made in 2025, origin Sunlight Foundation 2016-12-11, last updated 2022-11-21 (fetch, 2026-10-14). Archivarix mirror claims about 1M deletions 2012-2023 (third-party, unverified).
ui_notes: Deleted tweet pages show the tweet and the deleted label; per-party listing pages (e.g. /politwoops/party/d). Date, device and search per tweet not confirmed by fetch.
note: Notice says no longer maintained; archive still browsable. Content is public deleted posts of officials.

name: Filmot - YouTube subtitle, title and transcript search
what: Search engine over YouTube auto and manual captions, titles and channels, with boolean, proximity and wildcard operators, channel filters, saved searches and daily email alerts for logged-in users.
why_it_matters: Direct tool for finding which tech YouTubers said a phrase and when; the best candidate index for Theo Browne, Cole Medin etc.
numbers: Page claims 1.7 billion caption entries across 1.5 billion videos, 84 million channels, and 18 billion videos in metadata index (filmot.com, fetched 2026-10-14; self-reported, undated). Max 200 selected channels per search.
ui_notes: Result list shows matching caption lines; timestamp link behaviour not described on page.
note: Pricing, API and export not stated on the page (fetch of /api returned no API docs). Patreon/donation only. Terms link exists but was not read. Verify ToS before bulk scraping.

name: YouTube Help - subtitle settings and transcript view
what: YouTube's own guide to captions: auto-generated captions, and the Show transcript panel with in-transcript keyword search.
why_it_matters: Official source for which videos expose transcripts (most captioned videos) and how a timestamped line is shown.
numbers: Not a count. Auto-captions 'may misrepresent' speech (YouTube Help, 2026-10-14 snippet).
ui_notes: Transcript panel lists timestamped lines; clicking jumps to that time; search box filters lines.
note: Official help page; no licence concern for reading.

name: Glasp - YouTube transcript highlights
what: Browser extension that shows YouTube transcripts; highlights saved to a My Highlights page, and clicking a timestamp (e.g. 03:23) opens the video at that time.
why_it_matters: Shows a quote-with-timestamp-link UI that matches what we want for each 'said' row.
numbers: Free tier with daily limits (Glasp posts, 2026-10-14). Paid price not found.
ui_notes: Highlight -> saved quote -> timestamp link to the source video.
note: Highlights need an account. Glasp terms not read.

name: Snipd - AI podcast player with transcript search
what: Podcast app with transcripts with speakers, keyword and semantic search, clips ('snips'); English only for AI features.
why_it_matters: Consumer tool for finding podcast quotes by speaker; no API found, so not a join source.
numbers: Free: 2 episodes/week (Toolradar, 2026-10-14). Premium around $6.99/month per Toolradar (App Store prices vary by country).
ui_notes: Speaker-labelled transcript with snips linked to audio time.
note: Consumer app terms; no bulk export or API found.

name: Podscribe.io - podcast transcripts
what: Podcast transcription service. Name collides with an unrelated ad-attribution platform called Podscribe, so check which one.
why_it_matters: Possible transcription vendor for Musk podcast episodes we do not have transcripts for.
numbers: Free 60 min/month; paid from $15/month for 300 min (Podscribe-related listing, 2026-10-14); a 10web listing says from $5/month. Conflicting.
ui_notes: Transcript with search per episode.
note: Prices conflict across sources; confirm on the vendor page. Commercial terms apply.

name: YouTube Transcript Search (Chrome extension, eeebipno...)
what: Chrome extension that bulk-downloads transcripts for a channel's videos and searches across them, returning timestamps. 'ytks' was not found; this is the closest match.
why_it_matters: Channel-scale transcript keyword search for a YouTuber without a server; fits a per-person pull for Theo Browne or Cole Medin.
numbers: No counts. Store listing reviews only (2026-10-14).
ui_notes: Search results list lines with timestamps.
note: Chrome Web Store ToS; YouTube ToS restrict bulk scraping of transcripts. Check before automating.

name: Apify - YouTube Transcript Keyword Search (maged120)
what: Paid actor: give video URLs and a keyword, get matching transcript segments with timestamps.
why_it_matters: Programmatic option for batch keyword search across a YouTuber's videos, returning timestamps.
numbers: From $10.00 per 1,000 results (Apify listing snippet, 2026-10-14).
ui_notes: JSON output with start time and text per match.
note: Apify terms; third-party scraper, YouTube ToS risk.

name: Circleboom - X post CSV export
what: Paid tool exporting a public X account's posts to CSV with date, language, keyword and engagement filters.
why_it_matters: A route to 2025-2026 Musk posts that the Zenodo/Kaggle sets lack; the only current one-click export found.
numbers: One row per post, about 15 columns (Circleboom guide, 2026-10-14). Price not read.
ui_notes: CSV columns per post; no per-post UI.
note: Third-party; likely conflicts with X terms on scraping. Do not use for a redistributed dataset without a licence check.
